info.title: Caretly API
info.description: Render ZPL labels to vector PDF or PNG.

post.description: Send ZPL and receive the rendered labels. The body is either raw ZPL, or `multipart/form-data` with one or more ZPL files. Every `^XA…^XZ` becomes a page, and `^PQ` adds copies. A PDF contains every page; a PNG is one page, chosen with `page`. Requires an API key. Live keys are billed per label; test keys are free and watermark every label with TEST.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The output format. `pdf` contains every page; `png` is the single page chosen with `page`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: For `format=png`: the page to render, starting at 1. Pages are counted across all files of a multipart request. Out of range returns 400.

parameters.name: dpmm
parameters.description: Printer resolution in dots per millimetre: 6 (152 dpi), 8 (203 dpi), 12 (300 dpi) or 24 (600 dpi).

parameters.name: timings
parameters.description: Return server-side timings for each stage in a `Server-Timing` response header.

parameters.name: Content-Encoding
parameters.description: Set when the request body is compressed. The 100 MiB limit applies to the decompressed body.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any string up to 255 characters, for example an order number. A retry with the same API key, `Idempotency-Key`, labels and query parameters is billed once; different labels or parameters are billed as a new request.

requestBody.description: Raw ZPL, or several ZPL files as multipart form data. At most 100 MiB after decompression.

schema.description: Raw ZPL. May contain several labels (`^XA…^XZ`).

text/plain.example:
^XA
^PW800
^LL1000

^FX --- Outer border ---
^FO10,10^GB780,980,4^FS

^FX --- Header ---
^FO10,10^GB780,80,4^FS
^FO30,30^A0N,50,50^FDLABEL SYNTAX^FS
^FO600,35^A0N,30,30^FDPRIORITY^FS

^FX --- Addresses ---
^FO10,90^GB780,160,4^FS
^FO30,110^A0N,25,25^FDSENDER: Warehouse 42&43^FS
^FO30,140^A0N,25,25^FD123 Industrial AS, Sector 10^FS
^FO30,180^A0N,30,30^FDSHIP TO:^FS
^FO180,180^A0N,35,35^FDALBINS - CORP HQ^FS
^FO180,215^A0N,30,30^FD500 BUSINESS AVE, SUITE 100^FS

^FX --- Barcode ---
^FO10,250^GB780,200,4^FS
^FO100,280^BY4,2,120^BCN,120,Y,N,N^FD123456789012^FS

^FX --- QR code ---
^FO10,450^GB780,300,4^FS
^FO280,480^BQN,2,4^FDQA,https://labelsyntax.com/^FS
^FO250,710^A0N,25,25^FDSCAN FOR DETAILS^FS

^FX --- Footer ---
^FO30,770^A0N,30,30^FDREF: PO-998877^FS
^FO30,820^A0N,30,30^FDWEIGHT: 12.5 LBS^FS
^FO30,870^A0N,30,30^FDDIMENSIONS: 10x10x10^FS
^FO500,870^A0N,20,20^FDGenerated by AS^FS
^XZ

file.description: One or more ZPL files. Every part with a filename, or named `file`, `files` or `zpl`, is a file. Each file is rendered with a fresh printer state, and pages follow upload order.

X-File-Page-Counts.description: Multipart requests only: pages per file, in upload order, for example `2, 1`.

Server-Timing.description: With `timings`: duration of each stage in milliseconds (read, queue, parse, state, render, encode, total).

X-Labels-Billed.description: Labels billed for this request: every page, including `^PQ` copies, for a live key; 1 for a PNG; 0 for a test key.

RateLimit-Limit.description: The burst size of your API key's rate limit: how many requests it can make at once.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests your API key can still make at once before it is rate limited.

400.description: Invalid parameters, a `page` out of range, a multipart request without ZPL files, or a corrupt compressed body.

401.description: The API key is missing, not valid, expired or revoked. Create or renew a key in the console.

text/plain.example: An API key is required. Create one at https://caretly.dev/console/keys and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

402.description: Billing for the account is not active, so live keys are paused. Test keys keep working.

text/plain.example: Billing for this account is not active, so live keys are paused. Update it at https://caretly.dev/console/billing; test keys keep working.

413.description: The body is larger than 100 MiB after decompression.

415.description: Unsupported `Content-Encoding`. The `Accept-Encoding` response header lists the supported ones.

429.description: Too many requests for this API key. The rate limit is generous (about 50 requests per second with bursts of 200) and stops runaway loops. Wait the number of seconds in `Retry-After` and retry. See [Rate limits](/authentication#rate-limits).

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, rounded up.

RateLimit-Limit.description: The burst size of your API key's rate limit: how many requests it can make at once.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests your API key can still make at once before it is rate limited.

text/plain.example: Too many requests for this API key: the limit is 50 per second, with bursts of 200. Retry after 1 s.

bearerAuth.description: An API key from the [console](https://caretly.dev/console/keys), sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Live keys start with `zpl_live_`, test keys with `zpl_test_`.

apiKeyHeader.name: X-API-Key
apiKeyHeader.description: The same API key, sent as `X-API-Key: <key>` instead of the `Authorization` header.
